$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The marketing surface: glossgenius.com paints the Webflow variable layer and the flat palette (light only — no toggle, no dark media query applied); it is the only painted theme the marketing site ships.

$themes.name: App
$themes.$description: The app surface: app.glossgenius.com declares its glossDS layer (--content-*/--surface-*/--brand-*/--space-*/--font-*) on :root and scoped .light/.dark classes; the signed-out /login, /signup and /forgot-password forms paint the light set. The .dark class is declared but nothing signed out applies it.

$themes.name: Booking
$themes.$description: A published booking website's surface: every business gets a public <name>.glossgenius.com site with its own .tokens_glossDS__* token family (service cards, the professional select, the BOOK bar); captured on honeyhivesalon.glossgenius.com, which paints light.
